title: Spatial-Temporal Migration Playback
subtitle: Movebank Data Repository / Animal Tracking
description: A high-performance scientific web application built with Angular 22 (with Signals), TypeScript, Leaflet.js, and SCSS for interactive playback and visualization of animal migration telemetry over geographical map layers.
longDescription: Engineered for advanced animal migration analysis, this application combines Leaflet.js map integration with a custom timeline playboard featuring playback controls, speed scaling, and reactive state management powered by Angular Signals.

architecture.title: Spatial-Temporal Playback Pipeline
architecture.description: High-performance reactive architecture coordinating map rendering with temporal animation streams.
steps: Interactive map viewport rendering historical migration polylines and real-time interpolated markers via Leaflet.js
Custom timeline controller supporting play, pause, scrubbing, and speed scaling (1x to 50x)
Reactive state handling powered by Angular Signals for tracking playback time, active datasets, and speed
Robust data layer supporting Movebank formats with offline mock dataset fallback modes

scientificImpact: Allows researchers to visually analyze temporal patterns in complex animal migration paths
Provides smooth animation and scrubbing across vast chronological datasets without UI lag
Streamlines inspection of individual tracking trajectories and metadata
keyFeatures: Interactive Leaflet.js map integration rendering historical migration polylines and real-time markers
Custom timeline playboard with scrubbing, pause/play, and variable speed scaling (1x to 50x)
Reactive state management powered by Angular Signals for synchronized temporal data reactivity
Sleek scientific dashboard layout equipped with collapsible sidebar filtering and metadata tools
Support for Movebank CSV/JSON telemetry payloads with offline mock dataset fallback modes
Optimized rendering pipeline ensuring smooth animation across vast chronological datasets without lag
